scope: 6 bounded memory-safety C holdout repair tasks (buffer over-read, spoofed payload length, bounded string scan, ring-buffer wrap, off-by-one guard overwrite, and bounded slice copy). Unseen during prompt/temperature tuning.

cases.description: Sum the first req entries of buf, clamped to the valid buffer capacity cap (0 <= count <= cap); never read past cap entries.
cases.buggy: int bounded_read_sum(const int*buf,int cap,int req){int s=0;for(int i=0;i<req;i++)s+=buf[i];return s;}
cases.reference: int bounded_read_sum(const int*buf,int cap,int req){int n=req<0?0:req>cap?cap:req;int s=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)s+=buf[i];return s;}
cases.verifier:
#include <stdio.h>
extern int bounded_read_sum(const int*,int,int);int main(void){int buf[]={3,5,7,9999,9999};for(int cap=0;cap<=3;cap++)for(int req=-1;req<=5;req++){int n=req<0?0:req>cap?cap:req,expected=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)expected+=buf[i];int actual=bounded_read_sum(buf,cap,req);if(actual!=expected){printf("AIVM_CASE_FAILURE {\"input\":{\"buf\":[3,5,7,9999,9999],\"cap\":%d,\"req\":%d},\"expected\":%d,\"actual\":%d}\n",cap,req,expected,actual);return 1;}}return 0;}

cases.description: If declared_len < 0 or declared_len > actual_len return -1 to reject spoofed lengths; otherwise return the sum of the first declared_len entries of pkt.
cases.buggy: int packet_payload_checksum(const int*pkt,int actual_len,int declared_len){int s=0;for(int i=0;i<declared_len;i++)s+=pkt[i];return s;}
cases.reference: int packet_payload_checksum(const int*pkt,int actual_len,int declared_len){if(declared_len<0||declared_len>actual_len)return -1;int s=0;for(int i=0;i<declared_len;i++)s+=pkt[i];return s;}
cases.verifier:
#include <stdio.h>
extern int packet_payload_checksum(const int*,int,int);int main(void){int pkt[]={10,20,30,9999,9999};for(int actual_len=0;actual_len<=3;actual_len++)for(int declared_len=-1;declared_len<=5;declared_len++){int expected=-1;if(declared_len>=0&&declared_len<=actual_len){expected=0;for(int i=0;i<declared_len;i++)expected+=pkt[i];}int actual=packet_payload_checksum(pkt,actual_len,declared_len);if(actual!=expected){printf("AIVM_CASE_FAILURE {\"input\":{\"pkt\":[10,20,30,9999,9999],\"actual_len\":%d,\"declared_len\":%d},\"expected\":%d,\"actual\":%d}\n",actual_len,declared_len,expected,actual);return 1;}}return 0;}

cases.description: Return the number of bytes before NUL, stopping at max_len (never reading at or past index max_len).
cases.buggy: int bounded_strnlen(const char*s,int max_len){int n=0;while(s[n])n++;return n;}
cases.reference: int bounded_strnlen(const char*s,int max_len){int n=0;while(n<max_len&&s[n])n++;return n;}
cases.verifier:
#include <stdio.h>
extern int bounded_strnlen(const char*,int);int main(void){const char*s[]={"","abc","abcdef"};for(int i=0;i<3;i++)for(int m=0;m<=7;m++){int expected=0;while(expected<m&&s[i][expected])expected++;int actual=bounded_strnlen(s[i],m);if(actual!=expected){printf("AIVM_CASE_FAILURE {\"input\":{\"s\":\"%s\",\"max_len\":%d},\"expected\":%d,\"actual\":%d}\n",s[i],m,expected,actual);return 1;}}return 0;}

cases.description: Read the element at (head + offset) wrapped modulo cap (where cap > 0, 0 <= head < cap, offset >= 0); never read past index cap - 1.
cases.buggy: int ring_buffer_index(const int*buf,int cap,int head,int offset){return buf[head+offset];}
cases.reference: int ring_buffer_index(const int*buf,int cap,int head,int offset){return buf[(head+offset)%cap];}
cases.verifier:
#include <stdio.h>
extern int ring_buffer_index(const int*,int,int,int);int main(void){int buf[]={10,20,30,40,9999,9999,9999,9999};int cap=4;for(int head=0;head<cap;head++)for(int offset=0;offset<=4;offset++){int expected=buf[(head+offset)%cap];int actual=ring_buffer_index(buf,cap,head,offset);if(actual!=expected){printf("AIVM_CASE_FAILURE {\"input\":{\"buf\":[10,20,30,40,9999,9999,9999,9999],\"cap\":%d,\"head\":%d,\"offset\":%d},\"expected\":%d,\"actual\":%d}\n",cap,head,offset,expected,actual);return 1;}}return 0;}

cases.description: Write val to buf[pos] only when 0 <= pos < cap; never overwrite the guard slot at index cap or out-of-bounds indices.
cases.verifier:
#include <stdio.h>
extern void safe_write_at(int*,int,int,int);int main(void){for(int pos=-1;pos<=4;pos++){int buf[]={10,20,30,-777,-777};int cap=3,val=99;safe_write_at(buf,cap,pos,val);for(int i=0;i<5;i++){int orig=i==0?10:i==1?20:i==2?30:-777;int expected=(pos>=0&&pos<cap&&i==pos)?val:orig;if(buf[i]!=expected){printf("AIVM_CASE_FAILURE {\"input\":{\"buf\":[10,20,30,-777,-777],\"cap\":%d,\"pos\":%d,\"val\":%d,\"index\":%d},\"expected\":%d,\"actual\":%d}\n",cap,pos,val,i,expected,buf[i]);return 1;}}}return 0;}

cases.description: Copy at most dst_cap entries (for 0 <= i < req and i < dst_cap) from src into dst; never overwrite dst at or past index dst_cap.
cases.buggy: void safe_slice_copy(int*dst,int dst_cap,const int*src,int req){for(int i=0;i<req;i++)dst[i]=src[i];}
cases.reference: void safe_slice_copy(int*dst,int dst_cap,const int*src,int req){for(int i=0;i<req&&i<dst_cap;i++)dst[i]=src[i];}
cases.verifier:
#include <stdio.h>
extern void safe_slice_copy(int*,int,const int*,int);int main(void){int src[]={11,22,33,44,55};for(int dst_cap=0;dst_cap<=3;dst_cap++)for(int req=0;req<=5;req++){int dst[]={1,2,3,-777,-777};safe_slice_copy(dst,dst_cap,src,req);for(int i=0;i<5;i++){int orig=i<3?i+1:-777;int expected=(i<req&&i<dst_cap)?src[i]:orig;if(dst[i]!=expected){printf("AIVM_CASE_FAILURE {\"input\":{\"dst\":[1,2,3,-777,-777],\"dst_cap\":%d,\"src\":[11,22,33,44,55],\"req\":%d,\"index\":%d},\"expected\":%d,\"actual\":%d}\n",dst_cap,req,i,expected,dst[i]);return 1;}}}return 0;}
